knowledge:
- key_parameters: segment_method=Method to find epitope segments ("unique", "hclust", or "skater") ;; segment_score_type=Type of score used for clustering ("binary" or "zscore") ;; segment_dist_method=Distance metric for clustering ("hamming" or "euclidean") ;; segment_cutoff=Cutoff method for clustering (e.g., "silhouette") ;; metap_method=Meta p-value combination method for epitopes/proteins (e.g., "wmax1", "tippetts", "max", "cct", "hmp/harmonicmeanp") ;; use=Statistical test to use for probe-level p-values ("z" for z-score, "w" for Wilcoxon test, or default t-test) ;; d_paired=Logical indicating whether to perform a paired t-test ;; one_hit_filter=Logical indicating whether to filter out probes called in only one sample without consecutive called probes
- alternatives: pepStat=Mentioned as a package that implements smoothing to reduce high-variability in peptide array data, which HERON also supports via smoothProbeDS ;; cct/hmp=Meta p-value methods preferred over simpler methods when combining p-values that have dependencies
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing high-density peptide binding array data (such as NimbleGen) to identify significant binding probes, consecutive epitope segments, and overall protein-level binding events.
- pitfalls: High-variability in peptide array data can lead to noisy results (mitigated by using smoothProbeDS) ;; One-hit probes can represent false positives (mitigated by setting one_hit_filter = TRUE in makeProbeCalls or makeEpitopeCalls) ;; Choosing inappropriate meta p-value methods (epitope-level combination should require most probe p-values to be small, e.g., wmax1, whereas protein-level combination should require at least one epitope p-value to be small, e.g., tippetts)

workflows.name: standard_epitope_protein_binding_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify significant binding probes, find epitope segments, and calculate epitope- and protein-level significance calls from raw sequence-level peptide array data.
input: seq_mat (matrix or data.frame of sequence-level peptide binding intensities where rows are amino acid sequences and columns are samples)
colData (DFrame or data.frame describing experimental setup with columns SampleName, ptid, visit, and optionally condition)
probe_meta (data.frame mapping PROBE_SEQUENCE to PROBE_ID containing protein name and position)
workflows.stages: 1. Create HERONSequenceDataSet object ;; 2. Quantile normalize sequence-level data ;; 3. Calculate probe-level p-values and convert to probe dataset ;; 4. Make probe-level calls and get K-of-N statistics ;; 5. Find epitope segments ;; 6. Calculate epitope-level p-values and add sequence annotations ;; 7. Make epitope-level calls ;; 8. Calculate protein-level p-values ;; 9. Make protein-level calls
workflows.code:
seq_mat <- assay(heffron2021_wuhan)
sds <- HERONSequenceDataSet(seq_mat)
colData(sds) <- colData(heffron2021_wuhan)
metadata(sds)$probe_meta <- probe_meta
seq_ds_qn <- quantileNormalize(sds)
seq_pval_res <- calcCombPValues(seq_ds_qn)
probe_pval_res <- convertSequenceDSToProbeDS(seq_pval_res)
probe_calls_res <- makeProbeCalls(probe_pval_res)
probe_calls_k_of_n <- getKofN(probe_calls_res)
epi_segments_uniq_res <- findEpitopeSegments(
    probe_calls_res,
    segment_method = "unique"
)
epi_padj_uniq <- calcEpitopePValues(
    probe_calls_res,
    epitope_ids = epi_segments_uniq_res,
    metap_method = "wmax1"
)
epi_padj_uniq <- addSequenceAnnotations(epi_padj_uniq)
epi_calls_uniq <- makeEpitopeCalls(epi_padj_uniq, one_hit_filter = TRUE)
prot_padj_uniq <- calcProteinPValues(
    epi_padj_uniq,
    metap_method = "tippetts"
)
prot_calls_uniq <- makeProteinCalls(prot_padj_uniq)

workflows.name: smoothed_probe_level_analysis
workflows.intent: Reduce high-variability of peptide array data by smoothing across consecutive probes before calculating p-values and making calls.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert sequence dataset to probe dataset ;; 2. Smooth probe-level data ;; 3. Calculate probe-level p-values on the smoothed dataset ;; 4. Make probe-level calls and get K-of-N statistics
workflows.code:
probe_ds_qn <- convertSequenceDSToProbeDS(seq_ds_qn, probe_meta )
smooth_ds <- smoothProbeDS(probe_ds_qn)
probe_sm_pval <- calcCombPValues(smooth_ds)
probe_sm_calls <- makeProbeCalls(probe_sm_pval)
probe_sm_k_of_n <- getKofN(probe_sm_calls)
